lines.en: The current pushes and I go along.

lines.zh: 我一张一合，慢慢往上浮。
lines.en: I pulse open and closed, drifting upward.
My comb rows flash through the colors.

lines.zh: 我转过身子，让水从侧面过。
lines.en: I turn so the water passes my side.
The trench water carries me downward.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚上方轻轻打转。
lines.en: I turn gently above the coral.

lines.zh: 透明的身子几乎看不见。
lines.en: My clear body is nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我漂过一群小鱼的上方。
lines.en: I drift over a school of small fish.
The current shifts and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我一缩，往前挪了一小段。
lines.en: One pulse carries me a short way.
I slide along the layer of dark water.
The deep sea's cold closes around me.

lines.zh: 我从石缝上方慢慢飘过。
lines.en: I float slowly over the rock crevice.
My tentacles trail through the water.

lines.zh: 我随浪上下，像一片薄纸。
lines.en: I ride the swell like a sheet of thin paper.

lines.zh: 梳板一晃，整条沟都是彩的。
lines.en: With one pulse, the whole trench turns colored.

lines.zh: 我没骨头，转弯不用费力。
lines.en: I have no bones, so turning costs me nothing.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就换了个高度。
lines.en: The water shifts and I change my height.
I hang there, swaying with the water.

lines.zh: 一只小虾穿过我的身子。
lines.en: A shrimp swims right through me.
My glow is faint, almost gone.
I bob gently up and down.
A fish bumps me and moves on.

lines.zh: 我在等水把我带到别处。
lines.en: I wait for water to take me elsewhere.
The deep black is very quiet.
My comb rows ripple in sequence.
The current parts around me and closes.
I see one point of light above.
I think of nothing at all.
Another jelly drifts past my side.
I am small; nobody notices me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，让光穿过身子。
lines.en: I turn slowly, letting light through.

lines.zh: 你那么大，水都被你挤开。
lines.en: You are so big the water bends around you.

lines.zh: 你的灯把我的颜色照出来了。
lines.en: Your lamp brings out my colors.
You have stopped right above me.

lines.zh: 我凑近玻璃，轻轻贴了一下。
lines.en: I press up softly against your glass.
You reach out; I slip through your fingers.
You are watching me; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我的光映在你的镜片上。
lines.en: My glow reflects in your visor.
Your speech bubbles bump into me.
I loop around your headlamp.
You follow, so I drift slowly.
The blow nearly scatters me.
A corner of my body tears.
I shrink to a single bead of light.
My glow dims down.

lines.zh: 这么轻的一下就要我的命。
lines.en: So light a blow may be my death.
I cling to the stone, unable to move.
Part of me drifts away.
I try to pull myself together.
The water thins me further.
I have no strength left to glow.

lines.zh: 水里有细小的东西，我靠近。
lines.en: Tiny things drift here; I move toward them.
What you offer is far too big for me.
I eat only things smaller than sand.
That smell never reaches me.

lines.zh: 我朝饵的方向挪了一点。
lines.en: I ease a little toward the bait.
You wave it again and I follow.
My mouth is tiny; do not stuff it.
These crumbs will last me a long while.
The smell pulls me along.
You muddy the water; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我被推得打转。
lines.en: You bump me and I spin away.
I hit the coral and bounce back.
The current slaps me against the wall.

lines.zh: 一条鱼穿过我，我散了点。
lines.en: A fish passes through and I fray.

lines.zh: 我被你的靴子搅得翻过来。
lines.en: Your boot flips me upside down.

lines.zh: 两个水母撞在一起，粘住了。
lines.en: Two jellies collide and stick.
I am stuck to the stone, unable to move.

lines.zh: 冰块撞来，我软软地让开。
lines.en: Ice bumps me and I yield softly.
The flow stretches me into a ribbon.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推出了珊瑚区。
lines.en: That shove carries me out of the coral.
Another glow has come near mine.
Our comb rows flash at each other.
I turn slowly around her.

lines.zh: 两团透明的东西贴在一起。
lines.en: Two clear bodies press together.
I cannot tell which part is me.
The current strings us into a line.
Her colors are brighter than mine.
We rise together toward the light.
She thins away, and so do I.
This water is room for us both to drift.

lines.zh: 有东西落在我身上，滑走了。
lines.en: Something lands on me and slides off.
I try to wrap a pebble.
A grain of sand sticks in my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我托着一片碎壳往上漂。
lines.en: I carry a shell fragment upward.
This thing drags me down.
A scrap of meat weighs me down.
I gather the crumbs into my mouth.

lines.zh: 那根骨头从我身上滑下去。
lines.en: The bone slides off my body.
A bit of weed sticks to me.
I cannot let go, so I carry it.
A small cluster stirs in the water.
I drift toward those floating crumbs.

lines.zh: 有东西比沙大不了多少。
lines.en: Something barely bigger than sand.
A swarm of tiny shrimp gathers above.
I turn slowly toward the smell.
A thin stream seeps from the crevice.
My tentacles touch something.
There is food in that cloudy water.
I follow a faint line in the water.
This time it is finally within reach.
I drift toward it, very slowly.
It pays no mind to my small glow.
I let my tentacles stretch longer.
When it stirs, I shift a little too.
The water pushes me off; I correct.
I wait for it to swim into me.
It is a finger's width away.
My mouth has opened.
I stay still, like the water itself.
It is inside my shadow.
I touch it and it shivers.
My stings are thin as needle points.
It flicks me off and I drift away.
I am too weak to hurt anyone.
It hits me and ends up hurting itself.

lines.zh: 我缠住它的尾，被拖了一路。
lines.en: I catch its tail and get dragged.
It cries out once and flees.
I do not even know how to bite.

lines.zh: 我使了全力，也就是碰一下。
lines.en: All my strength is a faint touch.

lines.zh: 它身上沾了我的一点刺。
lines.en: It carries a few of my stings away.

lines.zh: 我从深水里一点点显形。
lines.en: I take shape slowly out of the deep.

lines.zh: 水流把我带到了这片沟。
lines.en: The current has brought me to this trench.
Another glow shimmers beside me.
The water here is cold and still.

lines.zh: 我被推到珊瑚的阴影里。
lines.en: I am pushed into the coral's shadow.
I open my comb rows for the first time.
Light is very far above me.

lines.zh: 我记不起成形之前的事。
lines.en: I cannot recall anything before my shape.
Small fish circle around me.
I begin to drift with the water.
Hot water nearly dissolves me.
I hit the stone and spread flat.

lines.zh: 我在空气里缩成一小团。
lines.en: In the air I shrink to a bead.
The blast shreds me into wisps.
A thin spike passes through me.
Light enters me and I lose form.
Not a crumb is left in the water.

lines.zh: 电在水里窜过，我发白发麻。
lines.en: Current ripples through and I go white.
I drift where there is no water.
